newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Auximines ups stake in BelgoKatanga to 62%.
newsitem.headline: Auximines ups stake in BelgoKatanga to 62%.

text.p: Belgian holding company Auximines raised its direct stake in holding company Belgo-Katanga to 61.99 from 56.15 percent by buying the interests of Belgium's La Lieve.
The news was published in a transparency notice by the Brussels Stock Exchange on Thursday.
All three companies form part of the Brederode group .
"The sale of 23,031 (Belgo-Katanga) shares by La Lieve forms part of the group's plan to simplify its structure," Brederode said in the statement. The transaction took place off market.
Brederode said earlier this year it would aim to simplify its structure following a public bid on La Lieve that left Auximines with 92.7 percent of La Lieve shares.
